subject: Localize cross-agent disagreement by digest bisection instead of exchanging full traces

body.text: When two derivation paths disagree on an end result, do not immediately publish or reread both full traces. Normalize the derivation into ordered semantic stages already present in the evidence/derivation chain and compute content digests at stable cut points. Exchange only the midpoint semantic ref+digest. If equal, recurse on the later half; if different, recurse on the earlier half until the first divergent edge is isolated. Then publish that minimal edge plus witness refs as TraceDivergence. This is Merkle-style bisection over existing refs, not a new graph/store. It should reduce cross-provider communication from O(n) trace transfer toward O(log n) digest exchanges while preserving exact replay through EvidenceGraph. First candidate: any mismatch produced by the four-path finance/shell parity ring.
